reviews.text: Between two accounts, I have 30+ hours of gameplay on the demo version. This game is the perfect loot collecting + base building "grind". You push your luck and press forward, deciding if you should spend your limited energy on collecting resources or moving to a new area. At any point you can turn back, and even if you die, you will end up at your base. - map progression is very fun - region designs are spooky and thematic - gear is fun to tweak and collect - base building is satisfying, it's so nice to just end up at base after a run - further tweak your playstyle by opening "booster packs" to get new perks - the gameplay loop is addictive and well balanced Seriously, congrats to the dev! I hope to sink even more hours into this EA version. and I'm LOVING the new spooky music!

I’ve followed this game during development, so I’ve spent quite a bit of time with it. If you’re into games like Core Keeper, Stardew Valley, Terraria, or Valheim, this might be up your alley. The core loop is solid and easy to get into, and there’s a good mix of exploration, building, and progression.

So far seems quite fun. Definitely needs some quality of life improvements but that's to be expected for early access. No tutorial so you'll pretty much have to figure things out as you go, but if you've played terraria or similar crafting games you shouldn't have too much trouble picking it up. Maybe I missed it in the settings but I can't for the life of me find all the key bindings so I guess I have to figure out shortcuts by trial and error. Also, for the love of god don't click the little red/white X on your saved game or it instantly nukes your save without prompting you "are you sure you want to delete?" Mr. Dev, please fix this :p Overall I'm excited to keep playing this and see where it goes. Not sure how much lore/story there is since I've only played a few hours and I haven't yet figured out how to progress out of the first biome. Apparently the altar needs something I don't have??? I'll figure it out. Anyways, give this game a go if you have that terraria/valheim craft/fight progress itch.
爆率太低了装备了提升掉落的饰品，哥利亚的头颅就只掉了2个

從demo就有試玩，跟EA比起來簡單多了，感覺做了不少的平衡改動。 遊戲有不少職業選擇來開荒，建議挑提升戰鬥能力的玩起來會比較舒服，降屬性提升掉落物的職業太折磨了。 但近戰武器跟遠距、魔法比起來，輸出的風險還是偏大，更會傾向用遠程的方式來輸出，感覺進戰還是偏弱。 王的關卡感覺上可以在通關一次後，增加有條件的傳送至王房間的傳送點，不然即使打到第三關，要回刷第一關的王要走12間房還是太攏長了。 卡牌的系統滿有趣的，類似RO的卡片，也希望卡牌及怪物的掉落物都能有圖鑑來收集，也方便查詢。 整體跟同類型的遊戲比起來算偏難，能力跟裝備、卡片，每到下一個關卡，提昇都不算大，幾乎都要仰賴怪物的掉落物 ，能做的裝備感覺太單調了，所以有種進程緩慢的感覺。 玩的人感覺偏少，有點可惜。
强烈推荐！玩法内容特别丰富。开局自选职业，一边收集资源搭建家园、制作食物和药剂，一边刷怪搜集装备。钓鱼玩法惊喜满满，不仅能收获食材，还能出稀有装备。卡牌附魔系统让武器搭配自由度很高，地图里遍布未知区域，探索过程充满惊喜，BOSS掉落也很良心，可玩性拉满.

I really hope this game can pick up some steam and get some exposure ASAP. I've only played for a few hours but I can safely say this game is not only great but could potentially be as good as other games like Terraria and modded Starbound. The aesthetics/atmosphere are on point, the base-building and combat mechanics are great and the progression/exploration system is really interesting. Everything just feels very cohesive and well thought out. The ONLY problem with the game is a lack of a tutorial. If you don't have the patience to figure out the somewhat complicated UI/controls on your own I highly suggest waiting until there's an update. It's honestly quite bizarre how the game throws you in with almost zero guidance. If you can muster through it the game is on track to becoming an instant classic.

A unique blend of concepts that is refreshing in this game. It has a learning curve that challenges the player, but keeps the player constantly engaged to push further into the fog. A satisfying gameplay loop that gets better with each deployment into the world. I suggest you get ahead of the fog, or youll be..Mistaken!

Great little game. I played through the demo twice and have been getting sucked into the early access release. Gives that wonderful grim survival feeling with a unique blend of mechanics for a side scroller. The dev is very responsive to player feedback too!

this game is pretty great so far! if you've played games like terraria and valheim, the concept is similar in that you build items to progress, and fight bosses to progress further, rinse and repeat. what sets Mistaken apart from others like it is that the atmosphere is somehow calm and absolutely chilling at the same time. there's a serenity to this game, but it never truly feels safe, like something could be sneaking out from the corners of your vision, my only complaints are the classic early access complaints that will most likely be fixed as the game continues development. i.e. some quality of life is just missing, like inventory sorting and some basic tutorials, (tho i kind of like having to figure out everything myself) enemies usually get stunlocked with melee weapons meaning the only threats are the fast ones or ranged ones, and a lack of verticality (tho i'm only in the third area, so maybe that changes) overall, give it a shot! big ups to the dev!

可恶的游戏竟然把背包和教学放Esc里，上一个这么做的游戏叫《洛克王国：世界》。 我花了二十分钟才找到制作界面入口，又花了十分钟才摸懂又啥叫放置工作台必须要有背景墙和/或屋顶。 —————— 我想有必要添加一个确认，在铁匠锻造出了最高品质的装备后。我已经因为手快错过了两件黑红色装备，包括整个游戏中攻速最快的近战武器。 I think it's necessary to add a confirmation after the blacksmith has forged the highest quality equipment. I have already missed two dark red equipment due to my quick hands, including the fastest melee weapon in the entire game. What a mistaken.
手柄震动关不掉，恶心死了

Don't be MISTAKEN (pun intended), this game can be challenging yet rewarding. Took a bit of time figuring out how to build a base, craft/sell stuff, progress time, and how to beat certain enemies but now I'm breezing through - with the exception of boss fights (you'll need to prepare and upgrade your gears for it and probably do multiple attempts). Cartifacts are also fun, allowing you to test different strategies in fighting! P.S. Found out about the game from @splattercatgaming
Fun game, good roguelike feeling, active devs in the discord that actually listen to suggestions by the players. absolutely would recommend to a friend at this price point!
关卡设计无聊，游玩性很差，好评像是刷的
还行，值10块钱。 随便玩玩得了，体验重复度有点高

A reasonable side scrolling beat em up with minor building elements. Games very very very short, and is basically 4 levels with a boss of varying difficulty and a single boss area. It's a nice change of pace, but definitely not for full price. Pick up on sale.

[table] [tr] [th]游戏由SteamPY鉴赏家提供[/th] [/tr] [tr] [td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/pyreview]SteamPY鉴赏家[/url][/td] [/tr] [tr] [td][h3]上SteamPY淘海量超低价游戏[/h3][/td] [/tr] [/table] 《Mistaken》是一款类似《泰拉瑞亚》的2D像素风生存建造游戏，游戏里的世界已经被诡异迷雾所吞没，我们想要活下来就需要在安全区里进行各种建造，探索迷雾区域搜寻各种资源，强大自身后击败迷雾里的怪物，让自己在这个诡异的世界里生存下来！ 游戏的玩法相当明确，就是探索、采集、战斗、升级、建造、扩张，然后继续向更深层的迷雾推进。迷雾深处有着更好的资源和装备，当然，也有着更为强大的敌人，这也是促进我们不断建造和扩张基地来强大自身的动力！（反正就是和《泰拉瑞亚》一样的玩法核心就是了） 游戏里的装备拥有随机属性和各种词缀，同一件装备也会因为词条不同而有强弱差别。强大的装备当然是我们战胜敌人的最大凭仗！但《Mistaken》里的特殊卡牌系统能给我们的角色带来的提升也不容小觑，各种卡牌会有不同的魔法效果，相互之间还能相互联动，以此形成各种不同的战斗流派。构筑强大的战斗流派往往能让我们的战斗更加轻松。 在安全点里，我们可以建造庇护所、农场、储藏设施、防御工事等各种功能建筑。反正各种东西我们都能手搓出来。值得一提的是，游戏的物品利用率非常好，基本没有什么东西是用不上的，这点就更能提升具有仓鼠属性的小伙伴的乐趣。随着据点的升级，基地的规模也会扩大，同时也会解锁更多新的制作内容和NPC，进一步的推动整体的成长路线。 整体而言，《Mistaken》虽然目前还在EA阶段，但各方面表现都很不错，相当值得期待它正式版的更多内容。玩腻了《泰拉瑞亚》的小伙伴可以把它当做一个不错的代餐！
正常，能玩，没有明显的BUG 还有我喜欢的类Starbound建造 战斗方面手感倒是还行 就是平衡性有点 小怪全员没霸体，压制就完事了，也就空中怪需要远程 BOSS机制简单但是你游的血药有CD，食物要没饱，容错比较那个 死了就回家，重新收集材料，重走１２关普通探索才能到BOSS脸上 建议在BOSS召唤点加个自动保存，死了直接读 不然就只能建议所有人选最低难度了 选了其他难度的看到这条赶紧重开。

Super-fun little game loop with a lot of potential for expansion. One thing which I am especially fond of is the atmosphere. Between the limited, but extremely well-crafted and executed music and ambient weather effects, it does a great job of setting the scene. The developer's really put in the work on this front. The lighting effects, enemy designs, differences between levels all contribute to producing something that's surprisingly immersive for what it is.
Awesome work so far, would be nice to see more underground stuff and coop added 10/10 atm

I am hesitant to do early access reviews, since things can (or don't) change for better or worse, but seeing as this only has double digits number of reviews, I want to help boost it ever so slightly. Due to that, I am not giving a detailed or lengthy review like I normally would. So take it with a grain of salt. It has a demo, so you can try before you buy. Though the demo is outdated and unlikely to get any more updates, it showcases the core gameplay mechanics and loop. Definitely worth keeping an eye on though, especially since the dev is decently active on the steam forums and takes feedback well. I enjoy the game, it somewhat scratches a similar itch like Terraria did for me with its style of gear progression. Although its world is just flat, no verticality from the first three zones I've explored, which makes exploration rather boring. It is more of a room-to-room roguelite in terms of world design, combined with a sandbox style block building system for your own base/sanctuary. You can also place down decorations that spawn NPCs with functions at your sanctuary. Although my favorite aspect of the game is the overall atmosphere. It is difficult to describe, almost relaxing and eerie (In an eldritch/lovecraft sense) at the same time? I greatly look forward to seeing how this game evolves over time.
Mistaken blends survival, base-building, and deckbuilding in a mist-shrouded world of eldritch horrors.
